name: spec-to-plan
title: Spec → Implementation Plan
description: Transforms a structured technical specification into a phased implementation plan with atomic tasks, DONE-WHEN criteria, and dependency ordering.
author: SolFoundy

inputs.name: spec_path
inputs.description: Absolute path to the spec markdown file

inputs.name: output_path
inputs.description: Absolute path where the plan .md will be written

inputs.name: focus_version
inputs.description: First version to plan in detail (others summarized)

agents.prompt:
Read the specification file at {{spec_path}} and extract structured data. Return JSON with this exact structure:
{
  "versions": [{ "name": "v0.X.Y", "features": ["..."] }],
  "adrs": [{ "id": "ADR-NN", "decision": "...", "status": "accepted|proposed" }],
  "api_functions": ["func_name(arg) → return_type"],
  "context_levels": [{ "name": "level_name", "description": "..." }],
  "known_gaps": ["gap description"]
}
Be precise: extract literal text from the spec, do NOT paraphrase.

Decompose {{focus_version}} (from phases: {{phase-analyzer.phases}}) into atomic, 2-4 hour tickets.

Generate 8-15 tickets with:
- id: TICK-NN (sequential)
- title: one-liner
- description: 2-3 sentences
- DONE-WHEN: 3-5 measurable acceptance criteria
- depends_on: [TICK-XX] (if any)
- files_affected: [path/to/file]
- agent: matos | janus | theia (who should do it?)
- estimated_tokens: rough estimate

Respect dependencies (foundations before features).

Return JSON array:
[
  {
    "id": "TICK-01",
    "title": "...",
    "description": "...",
    "done_when": ["criterion 1", "criterion 2"],
    "depends_on": [],
    "files_affected": [],
    "agent": "theia",
    "estimated_tokens": 8000
  }
]

Synthesize all outputs into a complete implementation plan:

Phases from analyzer: {{phase-analyzer.phases}}
Tickets for {{focus_version}}: {{task-decomposer}}

Construct a markdown plan at {{output_path}} with this structure:

# PLAN-{{project}}-{{focus_version}}.md

## Overview
Brief summary of the plan scope.

## Phases
| Version | Phase | Complexity | Sessions | Prerequisites |
|---------|-------|-----------|----------|---------------|
(table of all phases)

## Phase {{focus_version}} — Detailed Implementation

### Tickets
| ID | Title | Agent | Tokens | Depends |
|----|----|-------|--------|----------|
(table of tickets)

### Ticket Details
For each ticket: ID, Description, DONE-WHEN criteria, Files affected.

## Subsequent Phases (Summary)
(brief list of remaining versions)

## ADR Impact
(reference impacted ADRs from {{spec-reader.adrs}})

## Conventions
- Agent assignment: matos (Python/backend), janus (frontend), theia (specs/planning)
- DONE-WHEN format: measurable, verifiable at code review
- Dependencies: respect critical path from {{phase-analyzer.phases}}

Use the Claude Code Write tool to save the file. Return: {"path": "{{output_path}}", "line_count": N, "status": "written"}
